command:
cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
path = 'parsing/html/reader.go'
s = open(path).read()
s = s.replace('''type textToken struct {
\tdata string
\traw  bool
}''', '''type textToken struct {
\tdata string
}''')
s = s.replace('''\t\tcase textToken:
\t\t\tcurrent := stack[len(stack)-1]
\t\t\tif tok.raw {
\t\t\t\tcurrent.Text += tok.data
\t\t\t} else {
\t\t\t\tcurrent.Text += html.UnescapeString(tok.data)
\t\t\t}''', '''\t\tcase textToken:
\t\t\tcurrent := stack[len(stack)-1]
\t\t\tcurrent.Text += html.UnescapeString(tok.data)''')
open(path, 'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w parsing/html/reader.go && go build ./parsing/html/ && go test ./parsing/html/ 2>&1 | tail -5
